faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Browse the store and tap “Add” on any product to add it to your enquiry list. When you’re ready, open your list and tap “Send Enquiry on WhatsApp”. Your list arrives as a neat message, and we reply to confirm availability, the final price and delivery.
